messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "avoid hot, cold, or acidic drinks until morning"
set: ["avoid hot, cold, or acidic drinks until morning", "avoid driving or hazardous activities until effect known", "avoid driving or other dangerous activities until effects are known", "cold, pale, or blue fingers and toes", "avoid choking or gagging", "avoid driving or hazardous activities until you know how it will affect you", "avoid driving or hazardous activities until you know how tramadol will affect you", "take in the morning or at night", "avoid sunlight or tanning beds", "avoid broken or irritated skin", "avoid driving or hazardous activity", "avoid scars or stretch marks", "many people prefer morning", "taken in the morning", "avoid alcohol", "avoid breast-feeding"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
